1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 a6 4.Nf3.strategy: Develops a piece and adds a defender to d4 and to the e5 square before the centre is decided. Black's ...a6 has done nothing about the centre, so White simply gets on with development and keeps the pawn structure flexible.

1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 a6 4.Nf3 Nf6.strategy: Develops with a hit on e4 and steers back into the classical set-up. The extra ...a6 is a spare move there: it keeps White's pieces off b5 and prepares queenside play, but it cost a tempo in the centre.
